proxmox_host.description: Proxmox HTTPS API origin, for example https://pve.example.com:8006. Use the template node's endpoint with local storage; shared storage must be verified visible on both the upload and VM nodes.

proxmox_token.description: Proxmox API token in user@realm!tokenid=secret format. The first equals sign separates the ID; any later equals signs remain in the secret. Stored as a sensitive publisher binding and never delivered to the VM.

proxmox_insecure.description: Skip Proxmox TLS certificate verification, default true. Disable when the API certificate has a trusted issuer.

proxmox_template_name.description: Exact, case-sensitive name of one visible template VM, default GitHub-Runner. The trusted image must contain a clean cloud-init installation, systemd, a runner user, and /opt/actions-runner with its dependencies.

proxmox_vmid_begin.description: Start automatic VMID allocation at this integer, default 100. Terraform requires a value between 100 and 999999999; existing VMs are never adopted.

proxmox_iso_storage.description: Enabled, active storage supporting ISO uploads and visible on the cloned VM's node, default local. One credential-bearing NoCloud ISO is owned per Generation.

proxmox_cloud_init_cmd.description: Optional publisher-authored Bash preparation body, executed as root before the mandatory JIT handoff. Default empty. Use code only, never credentials; no variable substitution or JIT environment is provided. Failure prevents runner startup. This does not replace the one-job Listener bootstrap.
